changelog:
Initial release of the quality-training-planner skill.

- Enables rapid generation of actionable quality training plans for various scenarios (Quality Month, skill enhancement, new hire orientation).
- Produces structured, customizable training programs (objectives, course outline, methods, assessment, lecturer requirements, resource lists, Kirkpatrick evaluation suggestions).
- Strong boundary control: prohibits fabrication of company-specific content—such modules marked “to be supplied by company.”
- Plans output in both Markdown and a polished HTML report with timeline and evaluation visuals.
- Facilitates lightweight customization via interactive selection of participants, topic, duration, and company examples.
